name: Velilla de San Antonio (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, blue above and below and white at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Velilla de San Antonio (a patriarchal cross on red and a flame on blue).
history: Velilla de San Antonio adopted its arms and flag officially on 7 March 1991, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 22 April 1991; the flag is of proportion 2:3, divided per saltire, blue in the upper and lower portions and white in the lateral ones, with the crowned municipal arms at its centre.
